title: Corner: Sales One-Pager
summary: The one-pager Patrik sends within 24 hours of a live demo. Prospect-specific cover (swap [NAME] and [INDUSTRY]). Two pages max. Sent as PDF. Closes the deal or keeps it warm.
content:
Corner: Sales One-Pager

Usage: Send this within 24 hours of a live demo. Customize the cover with their business name and industry. Attach as PDF. Steffen formats into brand-compliant PDF template.

Template variables: [PROSPECT_NAME], [BUSINESS_NAME], [INDUSTRY], [AGENTS_SELECTED], [HOURS_SAVED_ESTIMATE], [PATRIK_PHONE]

PAGE 1: THE OFFER

COVER HEADER

CORNER
An AI operations team for [BUSINESS_NAME].

Prepared for [PROSPECT_NAME]
[Date]

SECTION A: WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

Headline:

Six AI agents. Working for [BUSINESS_NAME]. Starting in 48 hours.

Body:

After our call, we build a Corner office customized for your business.
Your agents know your clients, your workflows, and your priorities.
They work around the clock on the tasks that eat your time.

You log in each morning, see what they accomplished overnight,
approve what needs your sign-off, and get on with your day.

That's it.

SECTION B: YOUR TEAM

Based on what [PROSPECT_NAME] shared in our call, here's the team we'd build:

Agent Role What They Handle
[AGENT 1] Operations Task routing, priorities, daily briefing
[AGENT 2] Scheduler Calendar management, meeting prep, reminders
[AGENT 3] Follow-Up Client outreach, lead nurturing, response drafting
[AGENT 4] [INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC] [Pain point from discovery call]
[AGENT 5] Content Social posts, project updates, client communications
[AGENT 6] QA Reviews every other agent's work before it reaches you

For [INDUSTRY] specifically: [One sentence about the biggest time-waster in their industry and which agent handles it.]

Example for Construction: "Your estimating agent drafts proposals from your notes. Your follow-up agent sends them before your competition even picks up the phone."

SECTION C: WHAT THIS REPLACES

A part-time office manager:        $30-40k/year
A marketing coordinator:           $45-55k/year
A project management subscription: $300-500/year
Missed follow-ups (cost per lost lead): $5-50k+

Corner Growth Plan:                $3,500/month = $42,000/year

You get a 6-person AI team
for less than one part-time employee.

SECTION D: THE NUMBERS WE'RE TARGETING

Based on what you shared, here's what we'd aim for in the first 30 days:

Metric Estimate
Hours saved per week [HOURS_SAVED_ESTIMATE]
Admin tasks automated 80%+ of recurring items
Follow-up response time Same-day (vs. current 24-72 hours)
Missed leads Near zero (agent never forgets)

We track every one of these. Monthly check-in call: we show you the numbers. If they're not there, we fix the configuration until they are.

PAGE 2: THE DEAL

SECTION E: YOUR PLAN

Growth Plan — $3,500/month

Everything included:

  • 6 specialized agents built for [BUSINESS_NAME]
  • Unlimited projects and tasks
  • Full agent chat (talk to any agent, anytime)
  • Priority support
  • Weekly 30-minute check-in call (first 3 months, then monthly)
  • New skills and improvements shipped every month
  • 48-hour setup from signed agreement to live office

Month-to-month. Cancel anytime.

SECTION F: THE GUARANTEE

30-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

If Corner doesn't save [BUSINESS_NAME] measurable time in the first 30 days,
we refund your first month. No questions.

We're confident enough in the product that we don't need you to take the risk.

SECTION G: WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

If you're ready:

  1. Reply "I'm in" to this email (or text Patrik directly)
  2. We send a simple 1-page agreement — 5 minutes to sign
  3. We send a Stripe payment link for the first month ($3,500)
  4. Within 48 hours, your Corner office is live
  5. We walk you through it together on a 30-minute setup call

Timeline: Most clients go from "I'm in" to inside Corner within 72 hours.

SECTION H: ONE THING TO KNOW

We're taking 10 founding customers.

These 10 businesses will shape the product.
They get the lowest price we'll ever offer.
They get direct access to Patrik and Ash.
And they're the ones we'll write case studies about.

If this resonates, don't wait.
The 10 spots fill from our personal network first.

SECTION I: CONTACT

Patrik Matheson
Co-Founder, AOM

[PATRIK_PHONE]
patrik@aom-inhouse.com
aheadofmarket.com/corner

Book a follow-up call: aheadofmarket.com/book

DESIGN NOTES FOR STEFFEN

  • 2 pages max. This is a PDF Patrik emails, not a presentation.
  • Page 1: The offer. What they're getting. Why it matters.
  • Page 2: The deal. The numbers. What happens next.
  • Brand: Corner's white + calm energy. Not AOM's dark cinematic. This is the product brand.
  • The isometric office art appears once -- small, in the header area or as a right-column element on Page 1.
  • Tables should be clean and minimal. Thin borders or no borders.
  • The guarantee box in Section F: visual callout. Box or rule above/below. Must stand out.
  • Fonts: same as corner.app spec. Clean, human, not corporate.
  • Deliverable: editable template in Figma + exported PDF. Template variables are in [BRACKETS].
  • Page size: US Letter (8.5x11) or A4. Patrik's call.

FILL-IN GUIDE FOR PATRIK

After every demo, fill in these fields before sending:

[PROSPECT_NAME] — First name of the person you demoed to [BUSINESS_NAME] — Their company name [INDUSTRY] — Their industry (Construction, CPA, Agency, etc.) [AGENTS_SELECTED] — Which 6 agents make sense for their business (refer to Phase 3 auto-build table in corner-sales-plan.md) [HOURS_SAVED_ESTIMATE] — Based on what they told you on the discovery call. A contractor spending 15 hours/week on admin: estimate 10-12 hours saved. A CPA doing manual client reminders: estimate 6-8 hours/week. [PATRIK_PHONE] — Your mobile number

Total fill-in time: 5 minutes. Send within 24 hours of the demo. Not 48. 24.

EMAIL TO SEND WITH THE ONE-PAGER

Subject: Your Corner one-pager + next steps

Body:

Hey [PROSPECT_NAME],

Appreciate the time today. I enjoyed learning about [BUSINESS_NAME].

Attached is a one-pager with everything we covered: your team, the numbers, and how to move forward if it feels right.

A few things worth knowing:

  • The 30-day guarantee is real. If it's not saving you time, I'll refund the first month.
  • Setup is 48 hours from "I'm in" to live office.
  • We're keeping the founding cohort to 10 businesses. You'd be among the first.

If you have questions, just reply or text me directly.

If you're ready: reply "I'm in" and I'll send the agreement + payment link today.

Patrik

[mobile number] aheadofmarket.com/corner
